name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Mint distillation (nos)
brief: To motivate the Mint growers to set up modern field distillation units lined with Stainless steel in their fields to improve the efficiency of distillation unit as well as to improve the quality of oil for exports.
briefFull: To motivate the Mint growers to set up modern field distillation units lined with Stainless steel in their fields to improve the efficiency of distillation unit as well as to improve the quality of oil for exports.
details: The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Mint Distillation (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage mint growers to establish modern field distillation units lined with stainless steel in their fields. This helps improve the efficiency of the distillation process and enhances the quality of mint oil, thereby increasing its export potential. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
benefits:
- 50 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹ 1,88,000 per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 2,80,000/- per unit for SC/ST & 90% for Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subject to maximum of ₹ 3,38,000/-.
- Individual Growers owning a holding size of 0.4 ha to 8 ha and farmer’s groups/FPOs consisting of Mint growers as members. Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG
eligibility:
1.Preferably mint growing States and regions in India/UT.
2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Registration**
Step 1: The applicant should visit the [ServicesPlus](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/) website.
Step 2: Click on the “[Register” ](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html)option on the homepage.
Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha.
Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form.
Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.”
Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email.
**Login**
Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do)
Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha.
Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name.
Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form.
Step 5: Submit the application.

d) Bank pass book first page

faqs.q: What is the objective of the Mint Distillation scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme aims to encourage mint growers to establish modern stainless steel-lined field distillation units. These units help improve distillation efficiency, enhance the quality of mint oil, and increase its export potential.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for assistance under this scheme?
faqs.a: Individual mint growers having land holdings between 0.4 hectare and 8 hectares, as well as farmer groups and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) consisting of mint growers, are eligible to apply under the scheme.

faqs.q: What financial assistance is available for General Category beneficiaries?
faqs.a: General Category beneficiaries are eligible for financial assistance equal to 50% of the cost of the distillation unit, subject to a maximum limit of ₹1,88,000 per unit.

faqs.q: What assistance is available for SC/ST beneficiaries?
faqs.a: SC/ST beneficiaries can receive financial assistance equal to 75% of the cost of the distillation unit, subject to a maximum limit of ₹2,80,000 per unit.

faqs.q: What assistance is available for Spice Producers' Groups in identified clusters?
faqs.a: Spice Producers' Groups in identified clusters are eligible for assistance equal to 90% of the cost of the unit, subject to a maximum limit of ₹3,38,000 per unit.

faqs.q: Why are stainless steel-lined distillation units promoted under the scheme?
faqs.a: Stainless steel-lined distillation units help improve the quality and purity of mint oil, reduce contamination during processing, and increase the efficiency of the distillation process.

faqs.q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for availing assistance?
faqs.a: Yes. Aadhaar is a mandatory document required for identification and processing of the application.

faqs.q: Can farmer groups and FPOs apply for assistance?
faqs.a: Yes. Farmer groups and FPOs comprising mint growers are eligible to apply and receive assistance as per the provisions applicable to group beneficiaries under the scheme.

faqs.q: How does a mint distillation unit benefit farmers?
faqs.a: A modern distillation unit enables farmers to produce better-quality mint oil, improve extraction efficiency, reduce processing losses, and obtain better market prices for their produce.
